prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Conroe, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1113; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather not give my name on the recording, if that's okay. I can confirm I'm the driver of the vehicle involved.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident took place?

A: It was on a multi-lane road in Conroe, Texas, in the right-hand lane heading toward the shopping center area.

Q: What were you doing right before the collision?

A: I was changing lanes to move from the right lane into the middle lane. I checked my mirror, saw nothing close behind me, and started to merge over.

Q: Did you use your turn signal?

A: Yes, I activated my signal for a few seconds before I started moving over.

Q: What happened next?

A: As I was moving into the lane, a vehicle in the middle lane came alongside me and we sideswiped each other. I felt a hard jolt and heard the scraping along my passenger side.

Q: Did you see that vehicle before you began your lane change?

A: Not clearly. It was in my blind spot, and I didn't see it until contact.

Q: How did you feel after the impact?

A: I was shaken up, but I could move. Over the next day my neck became stiff and sore, and the pain runs into my shoulders when I turn my head.

Q: Have you sought medical treatment for your neck?

A: Yes, I was evaluated and I've been told it's a neck strain. I'm still going to appointments and taking medication for the discomfort.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?

A: Only that I want my vehicle damage and medical costs looked at fairly. I'm willing to provide any records you need.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
